summary: Comprehensive revised implementation plan incorporating dual-mode token verification (JWKS RS256/ES256, HS256 secret, getUser fallback), runtime GET /api/auth/config, real route allowlist with route-inventory test, server-side hashed MFA recovery codes + CLI reset script, atomic in_progress idempotency with broker reconciliation, QuickJS per-bar 50ms CPU limits and strategy regression test, 4-stage gated pipeline (1a, 1b, 2, 3), separate indicator vs visible-range draw benchmarks, and objectAuth test with hash-chained append-only audit.
